title: Mood check
intro: Low mood can look like memory trouble, and the two often occur together. Say: "Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?"

source.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The Patient Health Questionnaire-2: validity of a two-item depression screener. Med Care 2003;41(11):1284-1292.
